scene: The drone drops you onto the rooftop transit terrace high above the city.
picture: A flat side view of a wide rooftop transit concourse. On the far left, a moving walkway glides under a Starlight Arcade sign. Left of centre, the silver-haired boy in a mint hoodie and dance bag stands beside a departing drone. On the right, a river hover ferry docks. On the far right sits a light-rail pod.
shown: A glowing moving walkway with green arrow signs, waiting on the far left
A sleek yellow river hover ferry docked at a gate on the right
An open silver light-rail pod idling on rails at the far right
